name: UniversityMove_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving to a new city to attend university

setting.relationship_dynamic: Young adult and family member preparing for a first independent move
setting.background: The student is leaving their family home for university and moving into a small student apartment
setting.conversation_style: Practical preparation mixed with excitement about independence

scenario_template.note: They discuss what the student will need in the new city. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They identify clothing, kitchenware, bedding, study materials, and personal items. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They discover that the room is much smaller than the bedroom the student currently has. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Packing for a small student apartment
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They discover that the accommodation does not include one of the items they expected. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They finish the move and focus on making the small room feel comfortable and personal. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
